checks.detail: Blocked and full-unassessed under the incremental validation contract. Source ownership agrees with captured ordinary-input observations for authoritative HUD values, loaded icons, journal selection/tracking, completed training steps, save restoration, 3→2→1→0 deaths, notification clearing, nested pause ownership, mouse sensitivity, bounded wheel distance and wall shortening/restoration. Load Return and persisted mute pass condition 1. Condition 0 fails: retained feedback exposes Q02 and overlaps ammunition; H rebinding is intercepted by tracker collapse. Legal four/five-life histories, save failure/retry, remaining camera boundaries and the complete modal/notification scale matrix remain unverified. The final scoped runtime log is clean; an earlier broad digest exposed an NPC telemetry error. Supplied references support the serif, parchment and compact HUD direction; overlapping feedback remains a concrete readability gap. Missing dialogue portraits are a nonblocking continuity failure.

required_criteria.requirement: 按2026-10-07用户修订及 operator-ui-story.md 模块2，重做真实游戏内HUD/任务日志：命数使用已授权、风格协调的命火/护符图标表达真实3→4→5和扣命归零，不硬编码三格、不等同HP；检查点名称取消常驻，只在激活/改变/恢复时短提示，详细地点留在暂停/存档。成功保存约2–3秒淡出，失败明确可重试、不假报成功。任务HUD仅一个追踪目标及短行动/地标，接取/更新/完成短通知；任务明细进入精制日志，可打开/关闭、正确焦点、切换追踪并保留真实进度。退役旧Checkpoint文字卡和重复任务面板，不展示CP/Q编号、调试状态或开发验收文案。原生Control/主题/真实图标绑定同一任务、生命、命数、保存数据，保留战斗/危险/箭数/冷却/奖励，嵌套暂停和输入归属正确。实际对比PRD已有参考图，独立Tester验证普通输入、对白/日志/暂停切换、通知淡出、死亡/保存重载、1280x720/1920x1080及100/150/200%缩放。R24呈现规则同步修订，保存与复活玩法不减免。 同一模块完成鼠标镜头和滚轮：正常捕获时自由水平/上下环视，灵敏度生效；滚轮调整有界用户目标距离、平滑跟随且不被每帧常量覆盖，碰撞只临时缩短实际距离并在离墙恢复。瞄准进入/退出、切肩保持准星和自由观察距离；菜单/对话/日志消费滚轮并正确释放恢复捕获、不误攻击。复用现有player_controller/preview_controller的单一输入与镜头归属，保留弓箭IK/遮挡和Snaiel战斗。Tester普通鼠标/滚轮操作验证可见转动/缩放、墙边、瞄准和菜单边界，不能以代码存在视为通过。 取消左上角常驻F10黑底说明与旧目标/提示卡；教学按需出现并在实际学会后收起，帮助可回看。任务最多一个可折叠短目标，E交互仅在距离/无遮挡允许时于目标附近或下方显示，离开和开对白隐藏。Developer替换preview_controller的实际活跃卡片路径，不叠新UI，Tester普通画面检查漫游/教学完成/接近离开NPC与菜单状态。

developer_outcome.summary: Candidate implementation and bounded smoke are complete. Independent pointer, resolution, isolated history/fault, death/recovery and full audio observations remain unavailable. Legal 0–5 restore validation does not establish later chapter life awards.

risk_note.summary: The complete acceptance matrix can still end insufficient_evidence because the disclosed Computer-Use backend is unready and prior authorized controls did not demonstrate absolute-pointer/resize/fault coverage. Later chapter life transitions are also not established by this UI repair.
risk_note.validation: Host/Tester must independently supply ordinary mouse motion/wheel, absolute pointer, both resolutions, isolated valid/no-save/corrupt/failure histories and audio output capture. Keep unavailable cells blocked and distinguish restored life-count presentation from later chapter progression.
risk_note.why_now: Mouse/wheel and modal ownership are explicit parts of the active gate, while the pinned Load defect and mute leak already affect ordinary entry. Planning around unavailable observations would conceal required acceptance.

task_requirements.requirement: Ordinary gameplay provides a single compact HUD and a usable themed journal: lives reflect authoritative 0–5 values with real icons; HP, XP, arrows and danger remain correct; only one collapsible tracked objective appears; journal selection/tracking and completed steps reflect existing quest facts and survive save/load. Legacy checkpoint, duplicate objective and permanent F10 cards are retired. A.

The initially focused Return control is fully readable before manual scrolling for empty and populated Load slots at 1280x720 and 1920x1080 with 100%, 150% and 200% Chinese text; keyboard and pointer Return work. The persisted mute setting produces silent captured output across title, loading, gameplay, manual loading, return and restart, and unmuting restores normal output without overlap. Prior.
